description: This Java source file defines the GenericValue class, which handles persistence and relationships for generic entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating, storing, removing, refreshing, and retrieving related entities, as well as utility functions and nested classes.

classes.name: GenericValue
classes.description: A class representing a generic entity value object that manages persistence and relationships for entities in OFBiz.

classes.name: NullGenericValue
classes.description: A nested static class representing a null or placeholder entity value.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating new GenericValue instances from various inputs.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Persists the current GenericValue to the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the current GenericValue from the database.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the current GenericValue from the database.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Refreshes the current GenericValue from cache.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves related entities based on relation name and optional filters, with deprecated variants.

methods.name: getRelatedMulti
methods.description: Retrieves related entities across multiple relations.

methods.name: getRelatedOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single related entity, with deprecated variants.

methods.name: removeRelated
methods.description: Removes related entities based on relation name.

methods.name: getRelatedDummyPK
methods.description: Gets a dummy primary key for related entities.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow clone of the GenericValue.

methods.name: getStackTraceAsString
methods.description: Returns the current thread's stack trace as a string.
